_comment: Golden set for scripts/eval_retrieval.py, written on 7 Nov 2026 from passages
of lessons shown on production: Arabic, English and French, national and American
`answerable` queries name the lesson that should come back first. `expect` is
matched case-insensitively against the lesson title, so it only needs to be
the distinctive part of it; Arabic titles are matched with their vowel marks.
`unanswerable` queries have no answer anywhere in the corpus. The tutor must
decline rather than reach for the nearest thing, so what matters is that their
best score stays BELOW the worst answerable score.
The placeholder corpus this file described before (Jabir ibn Hayyan, the
teachers' pilot lessons) was archived on 2 Nov 2026 when the ministry books
